newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO-Russia meeting put off again.
newsitem.headline: NATO-Russia meeting put off again.

text.p: The inaugural meeting of the NATO-Russia partnership council has been postponed following a wrangle over the chairmanship, alliance sources said on Thursday.

The council, created to offset Moscow's anxieties over the alliance's eastwards enlargement, has not met since the two sides signed a Founding Act establishing a new post-Cold War relationship in May.
NATO sources said the council would probably hold its first meeting next week, but "certainly if at all possible before the holidays".

The council was to have met in Brussels on Thursday at ambassadorial level, but NATO and the Russians have been unable to agree the mechanics of how a rotating presidency involving both sides and the alliance secretary general would work in practice.
